explanation: Toru Iwatani said a pizza with one slice taken out gave him the idea. In Japan the 1980 game was first called Puck Man, from paku paku, the sound of munching.

claims.text: Pac-Man's designer, Toru Iwatani, said the character's shape was inspired by a pizza with a slice removed.
Iwatani did not name a wheel of cheese, a slice of lemon or a pie chart as the inspiration.
Pac-Man was released in Japan in 1980 under the name Puck Man.
The name Puck Man comes from 'paku paku', a Japanese expression for munching.
